summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing an update to the estimated financial impact from Toshiba's full-year results on ORIX's consolidated earnings for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. ORIX expects to recognize approximately ¥179.8 billion in equity-method income from TB Investment Limited Partnership in Q1, increasing net income by ~¥70.0 billion. This is an earnings guidance update, not a special situation event; no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category applies. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report on financial estimates.
